statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the label is included in the capability list returned by the server, the server MUST support all commands in that bundle.
actions: Support all commands belonging to the bundle indicated by the advertised capability label

statements.description: If the label is not included, the server MAY support none or some of the commands but SHOULD NOT support all of them.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Where a server does not implement a command, it MUST always generate a 500 generic response code (or a 501 generic response code in the case of a variant of a command depending on a second keyword where the base command is recognised).
statements.post_cond: (command.is_variant = false & response.code = 500) | (command.is_variant = true & command.base_recognised = true & response.code = 501)
actions: Send 500 response code when the command is not implemented
Send 501 response code when the unimplemented command is a variant whose base command is recognised
